title: Westwood CEO on the First ETF Listing on the TXSE
summary: Brian Casey of Westwood appears on the program as the segment tees up Westwood Salient Enhanced Power & Infrastructure ETF, ticker PWRX, as the Texas Stock Exchange’s first new listing. The actively managed ETF is designed to capitalize on accelerating power needs, pairing an income strategy with exposure to high-growth energy and infrastructure themes. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Tyler Kendall on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: LIV Golf Files for Bankruptcy Protection
summary: LIV Golf filed for bankruptcy protection, a dramatic fall for the Saudi-backed league that had big ambitions to challenge the supremacy of the PGA Tour. Randall Williams has more on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: El Niño Causes Panama Canal to Restrict Traffic
summary: Ilya Espino de Marotta is the new head of the Panama Canal Authority and she is already tackling some tough challenges. She says a strong El Niño has led to restrictions on ship transits and talks about how this weather pattern is impacting the business. She speaks to Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: A Sports Mogul's Empire Under Scrutiny
summary: Mark Walter pioneered how insurance companies invest policyholders' payments. His dealmaking spawned an empire that included some of the world's most famous sports franchises. But now, that empire is under scrutiny. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Japan’s Rising Yields Stir Debate Over Growing Repatriation Risk
summary: Japanese government bond yields near three-decade highs are giving fresh prominence to a long-discussed risk for global investors: the prospect of the nation’s vast pool of overseas capital returning home.

title: Latin American Currencies Lead Gains in EM With US CPI in Focus
summary: Latin American currencies gained on Tuesday, with the Chilean peso and the Brazilian real leading the advance on domestic headlines, as the dollar retreated.

title: Gold Slips as Traders Weigh Mideast Tensions and Dollar Moves
summary: Gold slipped as traders weighed the competing effects of rising Middle East tensions and the US dollar’s decline against the yen.

title: Post-Labor Day US High-Grade Bond Rush Gets Off to Slower Start
summary: The traditional post-Labor Day rush to sell US dollar high-grade debt got off to a slower start this year, as fresh market volatility kept some borrowers on the sidelines.

title: Google, Blackstone Venture Faces Delays at Data-Center Sites
summary: Alphabet Inc. and Blackstone Inc.’s new cloud venture has hit delays for major data-center locations that were supposed to run Google’s chips, underscoring the obstacles standing in the way of Big Tech’s AI ambitions.

summary: Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey announced major restrictions on data center development, including a requirement that companies procure their own renewable energy supply.

title: Cerberus Sells Real Estate Firm Tenet Equity for $1.6 Billion
summary: Cerberus Capital Management sold a net-lease real estate business it founded five years ago for $1.6 billion, capitalizing on demand for a type of property transaction that’s gaining popularity.

title: Lender Chaos Hampers Australia Developer Bathla’s Hunt for Cash
summary: Last Thursday, more than a week after Australian homebuilder Bathla Group tumbled into insolvency, a 24-hour deadline to secure emergency funding came and went, putting the company on the verge of liquidation.

title: Why the Bond Market Has Everyone On Edge
summary: On today’s Big Take podcast, Bloomberg’s John Authers joins guest host Stacey Vanek Smith to talk through why the current action in the bond market could be a correction instead of a crisis. Listen wherever you get your podcasts. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: SpaceX Shares to Get a Boost If Nasdaq 100 Increases Weighting
summary: Bloomberg's Carmen Reinicke said that thousands of SpaceX shares are set to come back into the market as the Nasdaq 100 index goes through rebalancing and the space company sees more stock lockup expirations. Reinicke called the potential for stock movement 'really substantial' and said that SpaceX's weight in the Nasdaq 100 will only continue to rise until all available shares are bought.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 8
summary: Brent oil advanced to the highest since late July as another round of strikes on Middle East energy infrastructure, including reported explosions at Iran’s vital export hub Kharg Island, stoked fears of fresh supply tightness.

title: Major Food Companies Allege US Sugar Producers Colluded on Price
summary: General Mills Inc., Mars Inc. and McKee Foods Corp. joined a growing list of food manufacturers and grocers in antitrust litigation that alleges top US sugar producers colluded to inflate prices for the sweetener used in many of the snacks and drinks Americans consume every day.

title: Bessent’s ‘Fever’-Quelling Debt Buybacks Put Wall Street on Edge
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is set to reveal how far he’s initially willing to go restrain US bond yields via an expanded buyback program that has Wall Street dealers on edge.
